messages:
alex: Observing control-plane packet loss in eu-west1 affecting allocator heartbeats. GPU node assignments are stalling, pods entering Pending. @liam_infra can you confirm?
liam_infra: yup seeing increased API latency to scheduler (p95 ~1.2s -> 4.6s). Some Dedicated pools report backpressure. Logs show kube-apiserver <-> allocator TCP retransmits.
maya_prod: Impact: customer traffic hits long queuing; streaming responses stall. User-facing error rate up ~3.2% for eu-west1.
sam_sre: Flagging incident and recommending emergency shaping per-tenant while we investigate network layer. Anyone object to applying a short softcap? :thinking_face:
ops_lead: We need an action that preserves SLAs for enterprise customers. Propose: 1) Apply conservative per-tenant token shaper at edge (burst 2k tokens/min, sustained 600 tpm) 2) Route non-enterprise to alternate region eu-central1 where capacity exists 3) Open HAC (customer comms).
liam_infra: Technically doable. I can push a shaper via the traffic-agent and update the routing policy with a single CLI. Plan for a 5-min canary then full roll.
alex: Can you paste the CLI snippet you’ll run so we can audit?
liam_infra: paste:
```
# apply emergency shaper to eu-west1 edge
rctl traffic apply --region eu-west1 --policy emergency-shaper \
  --match "tier:free|tier:standard" --burst 2000 --rate 600 --duration 30m
# route standard to eu-central1
rctl route update --from-region eu-west1 --to-region eu-central1 --match "tier:standard" --mode failover --weight 0.75
```
maya_prod: Add a fallback that automatically removes shaper if queue depth drops below threshold to avoid over-throttling.
liam_infra: I'll include a health-check watch: if api_latency_p95 < 1s and pending_pods < 2% for 3 consecutive minutes we auto-roll back.
sam_sre: Notify support so they can page affected customers and mark incidents dashboard. @iris_support pls prepare template.
iris_support: Working on message. Draft: "We are investigating degraded inference performance in eu-west1. We've applied temporary traffic shaping to stabilise platform performance while we fail over traffic. No data exposure. ETA 30-60m." Want to add scheduled updates cadence?
ops_lead: 15m initial, then 30m. Also ask sales/AE for any enterprise impacts.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: eu-west1 control-plane packet-loss -> emergency shaping applied (incident id: INC-2026-045).
deploy-bot: rollout started: emergency-shaper policy -> canary on 10% of edge nodes (eu-west1) at 2026-03-18T18:12:00Z.
liam_infra: Canary metrics after 2m: canary nodes show request latency 20% reduced queuing, no allocator errors on those nodes. Proceeding to full roll at +4m.
maya_prod: Remember to update the cost tracker — cross-region traffic to eu-central will increase egress spend and GPU hours. Estimate +8-12% delta if sustained.
alex: Good point. Add a flag to the incident doc: "cost_sensitive = true" and tag finance.
sam_sre: Post-mortem owners? Recommend liam_infra (infra cause), maya_prod (product impact), iris_support (customer comms).
ops_lead: agreed. After stabilise, run a capacity audit of eu-west1 networking and scheduler timeouts; consider increasing allocator-heartbeat retry window as short-term mitigation.
liam_infra: Captured. Will also open a ticket with cloud provider for packet loss trace.
alex: Great. Keep updates here. If anything changes escalate to P1. :thumbsup:
